$comment: The flamapy plugins the IDE knows, and the core wheels flamapy itself needs. Tracked template: wheels are listed by bare distribution name (e.g. 'flamapy_sat'); `make build-wheels` resolves them to the versioned wheel files and writes the served plugins.conf.json (gitignored). Every plugin follows the same rule: it is installed when the user installed it, or when it is `preinstalled` and the user has not removed it. `available: false` plugins (no Pyodide build yet) are listed with their `note` but can't be installed. Installs use micropip with deps=False, so `wheels` must list every dependency wheel and `pyodidePackages` every package Pyodide serves itself.

plugins.label: SAT
plugins.description: SAT solver backend (flamapy-sat, PySAT): satisfiability, configurations, dead, core and false-optional features, sampling, backbone, diagnosis and attribute optimisation (MaxSAT).

plugins.label: BDD
plugins.description: Binary Decision Diagram backend (flamapy-bdd, dd): exact configuration counting, uniform sampling, configuration distribution and feature inclusion probabilities.

plugins.label: Z3
plugins.description: SMT backend (flamapy-z3, Z3) for models with typed (numerical) attributes: analysis, feature bounds and multi-objective attribute optimisation.
plugins.note: Z3 compiled to WebAssembly (a large download: about 17 MB).

plugins.label: SDD
plugins.description: Sentential Decision Diagram backend (flamapy-sdd). Adds satisfiable, configurations number, core and dead features via an SDD compilation of the model.
plugins.note: SDD compilation (UCLA libsdd 2.0 via PySDD) compiled to WebAssembly.

plugins.label: d-DNNF
plugins.description: Deterministic Decomposable Negation Normal Form backend (flamapy-dnnf) for exact model counting and related analyses.
plugins.note: Requires the external d4 compiler invoked via subprocess; not portable to Pyodide (no process spawning in the browser) without porting d4 to wasm and rewriting the plugin to call it in-process.

plugins.label: #SAT
plugins.description: Sharp-SAT backend (flamapy-sharpsat) for (approximate) configuration counting on large models.
plugins.note: Approximate counting (ApproxMC) and almost-uniform sampling (UniGen) compiled to WebAssembly.
